title: Count a halogen addition
statement:
In C₂H₄ + Cl₂ → C₂H₄Cl₂, which bond change is included for the product?

[_]{a}

choices: Formation of a carbon–carbon triple bond
explanations: Each added Cl bonds to a different carbon.
The Cl–Cl reactant bond is broken.
The product contains only two chlorine atoms.

hints: Chlorine adds across the double bond.
One chlorine bonds to each carbon.
solution: Chlorine adds across the double bond. The C=C changes to C–C. One chlorine bonds to each carbon. Each added Cl bonds to a different carbon.
